usages.explain: 「 どこ」is an interrogative word asking about a location, while「 どちら」is an interrogative word asking about a direction. However,「 どちら」can also be used to ask about a location. In this case,「 どちら」carries a more polite tone than「 どこ」.

examples.transcription: かいぎしつはどこですか。
おくにはどちらですか。
がっこうはどこですか。
かいしゃはどちらですか。

usages.explain: Note: In addition, when asking about the name of a country, company, school, organization, or affiliated institution, we also use the interrogative words 「 どこ」or「 どちら」  instead of 「 なん」. In this case, 「 どちら」 also conveys a more polite tone than 「 どこ」.
